0f3c9405949ba85d.column_purpose: Episode title, e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!', 'Fall of the Blue Beetle!' — all Batman: The Brave and the Bold episode titles.

4eac0ed0ee7ef123.column_purpose: Episode director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang).

4354e6e6cab301b1.column_purpose: Episode writer(s), e.g. J. M. DeMatteis, Steven Melching, Joseph Kuhr.

fb6b4f3a5a4b27f6.column_purpose: Original US air date stored as text without spaces, e.g. 'November21,2008', 'January23,2009'.

4a1ae95521889170.column_purpose: Production code of the episode (101-112), sequential with episode number.

4654e1ce795dbdb8.column_purpose: Foreign key to TV_Channel.col_001; identifies the row of the channel catalogue for the channel this episode aired on. Values 700-728 correspond to music/TV channels (e.g. MTV Hits, MTV Dance) on the Sky Italy platform, an odd pairing for a Batman cartoon, but the join is established.

37ba8bdc8cecaa94.column_purpose: Primary key; numeric channel identifier (likely the channel number on the platform, 700-728), stored as text. Referenced by TV_series.col_009 and Cartoon.col_007.

b0637398596e74ca.column_purpose: Unique human-readable name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits', 'MTV Dance').

2bed17b703ebfa05.column_purpose: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

899d5fa87ef8c14d.column_purpose: Primary broadcast language of the channel (Italian, English); consistent with the country column.

3db7079afea2ee8d.column_purpose: Content genre of the channel; constant value 'music' for all rows.

dda430ac3a726185.column_purpose: Picture aspect ratio of the broadcast: '4:3', '16:9', or '4:3 / 16:9' (both available).

13718ae0d06811bc.column_purpose: Yes/no flag; only one channel differs. Plausibly indicates whether the channel is broadcast in HD (or some other channel attribute such as 'is_new'); the specific attribute cannot be confirmed from values alone.

c1e0e42a8dbfb36a.column_purpose: Pay-TV package/bundle in which the channel is offered on the Sky platform: 'Sky Famiglia', 'Sky Famiglia + Sky HD', 'Option', or 'no ( FTV )' meaning free-to-view.

9bba0b05241f0fb3.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential episode number (1-12), one row per episode.

bbd700d745edf835.column_purpose: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback'); unique per row.

5081ef031d8e63c6.column_purpose: Original U.S. broadcast date of the episode, stored as text in 'Month DD, YYYY' format; all values fall in October-December 2007, consistent with a weekly series.

e9c48261f36e01c7.column_purpose: Nielsen household rating points (e.g. 2.4, 3.2), the first component of the 'R/S' pair in col_006; values match col_006's rating component. The join to Cartoon.col_001 is spurious and ignored. Could alternatively be the share component, but the rating reading fits the numeric ranges better.

a919f1cca8d66065.column_purpose: Share of viewing audience (e.g. 6, 8), the second component of the 'R/S' pair in col_006; values match col_006's share component. The join to Cartoon.col_001 is spurious and ignored. Could alternatively be the rating component, but the share reading fits the numeric ranges better.

14412f66170c5826.column_purpose: Nielsen-style rating/share pair written as 'R/S' (e.g. '2.4/6', '3.2/8'): household rating points over share of viewing audience. The two components also independently match the ranges of col_004 (rating) and col_005 (share), suggesting col_004/col_005 are the split-out rating and share values.

6805a4003d67aca2.column_purpose: Audience size in millions of viewers (4.24-9.16), consistent with U.S. broadcast ratings for a 2007 network drama. The one-to-one join to Cartoon.col_001 is spurious and should be ignored.
